source_conclusions: Original Bionic seccomp install_filter requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN or NNP; it does not set NNP itself. This is source analysis, not successful filter execution.

Original selinux_android_setcontext returns0 when SELinux is disabled; otherwise computes seapp, validates context and setcon then reinitializes property mappings. A successful return alone is insufficient evidence of an assigned application domain.
Original seapp no-match path errors in enforcing, can return0 in permissive; verify actual context/domain and properties independently.

GSI plat_seapp_contexts selects untrusted_app for ordinary targetSDK>=34, levelFrom=all. Markor target35 suggests this branch only if real PackageManager signature/seinfo, UID, privilege flags and rule precedence agree; no UID or context allocated, no app launched.
limitations: No continuous asynchronous monitor yet; lifecycle caller must still observe control/pidfd, descendant handling and recovery remain open.
Drop can wait on uninterruptible child; no hard watchdog guarantee.
No original services started, no policy load/enforcing/relabel/reboot or changes to default policy.
No APK stage, external-service/DRM or ARM compatibility claim. Regression helper is Python, not an application.
next: Implement bounded post-start lifetime observation of both pidfd and control channel, including failures after startup and descendants holding a channel; keep coherent service identity/capability/NNP/stdio/device/cgroup inventory and S0–S2 gates open. Do not launch original service cohort under a permissive success assumption.
